name: stackql-provider-gemini
description: StackQL provider for the Google Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com), mastered from one factory pipeline

scripts.split: node node_modules/@stackql/provider-utils/bin/provider-dev-utils.mjs split --api-doc provider-dev/source/gemini-prepassed.yaml --provider-name gemini --output-dir provider-dev/source/split --svc-discriminator function --svc-discriminator-fn factory/service-map.mjs --overwrite
scripts.normalize: node node_modules/@stackql/provider-utils/bin/provider-dev-utils.mjs normalize --api-dir provider-dev/source/split && node factory/scrub-unions.mjs --api-dir provider-dev/source/split
scripts.generate: node node_modules/@stackql/provider-utils/bin/provider-dev-utils.mjs generate --input-dir provider-dev/source/split --output-dir provider-dev/openapi/src/gemini --config-path provider-dev/config/all_services.csv --provider-id gemini --servers '[{"url":"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com"}]' --provider-config '{"auth":{"type":"custom","location":"header","name":"x-goog-api-key","credentialsenvvar":"GEMINI_API_KEY"}}' --views-dir provider-dev/views --naive-req-body-translate --overwrite && node factory/post-pass.mjs --provider-root provider-dev/openapi/src/gemini/v00.00.00000
scripts.build: npm run convert && npm run prepass && npm run split && npm run normalize && npm run analyze && npm run generate && npm run guards
scripts.docgen: node -e "fs.rmSync('website/docs/services',{recursive:true,force:true})" && node node_modules/@stackql/provider-utils/bin/docgen-utils.mjs generate-docs-v2 --provider-name gemini --provider-dir provider-dev/openapi/src/gemini/v00.00.00000 --output-dir website --provider-data-dir provider-dev/docgen/provider-data/gemini && node factory/enrich-select-docs.mjs --provider gemini --provider-root provider-dev/openapi/src/gemini/v00.00.00000 --docs-dir website/docs --examples factory/docgen-select-examples.yaml && node factory/scrub-docs.mjs --docs-dir website/docs --provider-root provider-dev/openapi/src/gemini/v00.00.00000 && node -e "fs.cpSync('provider-dev/docgen/provider-data/gemini/static-docs','website/docs',{recursive:true})"
